DEPOSIT £500 - Beautifully presented three bedroom unfurnished apartment for rent in Edinburgh. TO BOOK A VIEWING ONLINE, PLEASE FILL OUT CONTACT AGENT FORM.

Tenants have the opportunity to obtain a key to the exclusive Moray Place gardens or Dean gardens running along the Water of Leith. The property has a gas central heating system and wiring for surround sound and satellite TV.  NON HMO
